quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: The first meal of the day, eaten in the morning.
quests.explanation: Breakfast is the meal we eat when we wake up. 'Eat breakfast' is one of the most common phrases in everyday English.
quests.textToSpeak: Every morning, my brother eats breakfast before school.
quests.textWithBlanks: Every morning, my brother eats ___ before school.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: An outdoor area next to a house where plants and flowers grow.
quests.explanation: A garden is a place for growing plants, often behind or beside a house. 'Grow flowers in the garden' is a very natural everyday sentence.
quests.textToSpeak: My grandmother grows flowers in her garden.
quests.textWithBlanks: My grandmother grows flowers in her ___.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: The person who helps students learn in a classroom.
quests.explanation: A teacher works in a school and helps students learn. 'The teacher writes on the board' describes a very common classroom scene.
quests.textToSpeak: Our teacher writes the new words on the board.
quests.textWithBlanks: Our ___ writes the new words on the board.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: Something you open to stay dry when it rains.
quests.explanation: We use an umbrella to stay dry in the rain. Notice the word 'an' before it — umbrella starts with a vowel sound.
quests.textToSpeak: Take an umbrella with you because it might rain later.
quests.textWithBlanks: Take an ___ with you because it might rain later.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: A vehicle with two wheels that you pedal to move.
quests.explanation: A bicycle, or 'bike' for short, is a common way to travel short distances. Notice we say 'ride a bicycle,' never 'drive a bicycle.'
quests.textToSpeak: He rides his bicycle to the park every weekend.
quests.textWithBlanks: He rides his ___ to the park every weekend.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: The room in a house where food is prepared and cooked.
quests.explanation: The kitchen is the room used for cooking. 'Cook in the kitchen' is a simple, natural phrase you will use often.
quests.textToSpeak: My father cooks dinner in the kitchen every evening.
quests.textWithBlanks: My father cooks dinner in the ___ every evening.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: A round fruit that can be red, green, or yellow.
quests.explanation: An apple is one of the most common fruits in English. Again, 'an' is used here because apple begins with a vowel sound.
quests.textToSpeak: She packs an apple in her son's lunch box.
quests.textWithBlanks: She packs an ___ in her son's lunch box.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: School work that students complete at home, not in class.
quests.explanation: Homework is the work teachers give students to do outside of school. 'Finish your homework' is something parents often say.
quests.textToSpeak: The children finish their homework before dinner.
quests.textWithBlanks: The children finish their ___ before dinner.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: Water that falls from clouds during a storm.
quests.explanation: Rain is one of the most common weather words in English. 'Stopped just before' shows the timing was lucky for the players.
quests.textToSpeak: The rain stopped just before the football match started.
quests.textWithBlanks: The ___ stopped just before the football match started.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: A person trained to treat sick or injured people.
quests.explanation: A doctor helps people who are ill or hurt. 'Become a doctor' is a natural way to talk about a future career.
quests.textToSpeak: My sister wants to become a doctor and work in a hospital.
quests.textWithBlanks: My sister wants to become a ___ and work in a hospital.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: A structure built over a river or road so people can cross.
quests.explanation: A bridge connects two sides of a river, road, or valley. 'Cross a bridge' is the standard verb we use with this word.
quests.textToSpeak: Cars slowly crossed the old bridge over the river.
quests.textWithBlanks: Cars slowly crossed the old ___ over the river.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: A piece of clothing worn over a shirt to keep you warm.
quests.explanation: A jacket is outer clothing worn for warmth. This sentence shows a clear cause and effect — it's cold, so a jacket is needed.
quests.textToSpeak: It's cold outside, so wear your warm jacket.
quests.textWithBlanks: It's cold outside, so wear your warm ___.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: The yearly date that celebrates the day someone was born.
quests.explanation: A birthday happens once a year and is often celebrated with a party. 'Surprise party' is a common way to mark this special day.
quests.textToSpeak: We are planning a surprise party for her birthday.
quests.textWithBlanks: We are planning a surprise party for her ___.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: A building full of books that people can borrow for free.
quests.explanation: A library lends books to the public at no cost. 'Borrow from the library' is a phrase you will use often as a reader or student.
quests.textToSpeak: He borrowed three books from the library yesterday.
quests.textWithBlanks: He borrowed three books from the ___ yesterday.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: A small tool with a rounded end, used for eating soup or cereal.
quests.explanation: A spoon is the right tool for liquid foods like soup. The sentence also teaches a useful contrast, since a fork would not work well here.
quests.textToSpeak: Use a spoon to eat your soup, not a fork.
quests.textWithBlanks: Use a ___ to eat your soup, not a fork.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: Soft white flakes that fall from the sky in cold weather.
quests.explanation: Snow falls in cold weather and is often used to build snowmen. 'Fell all night' tells us there was plenty on the ground by morning.
quests.textToSpeak: The children built a snowman after the snow fell all night.
quests.textWithBlanks: The children built a snowman after the ___ fell all night.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: A small piece of paper that lets you travel or enter a place.
quests.explanation: A ticket proves you have paid to travel or enter somewhere. 'Buy a ticket' is essential vocabulary for buses, trains, and planes.
quests.textToSpeak: Don't forget to buy your ticket before the train leaves.
quests.textWithBlanks: Don't forget to buy your ___ before the train leaves.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: A person who grows crops or raises animals for a living.
quests.explanation: A farmer works on a farm, often starting very early in the day. 'Feed the animals' describes one of a farmer's daily tasks.
quests.textToSpeak: The farmer wakes up early to feed the animals.
quests.textWithBlanks: The ___ wakes up early to feed the animals.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: A piece of glass that shows your reflection.
quests.explanation: A mirror lets you see yourself, which is why people check one before going out. 'Look in the mirror' is a very common daily habit.
quests.textToSpeak: She looked in the mirror before leaving the house.
quests.textWithBlanks: She looked in the ___ before leaving the house.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: A healthcare worker who cares for patients, often in a hospital.
quests.explanation: A nurse looks after patients and supports doctors. 'Check someone's temperature' is a common phrase in everyday medical situations.
quests.textToSpeak: The kind nurse checked his temperature twice.
quests.textWithBlanks: The kind ___ checked his temperature twice.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: A large area of land covered with many trees.
quests.explanation: A forest is full of trees and can be easy to get lost in. 'Deep into the forest' suggests they walked far from the entrance.
quests.textToSpeak: They walked deep into the forest looking for the trail.
quests.textWithBlanks: They walked deep into the ___ looking for the trail.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: A soft, thick cover used on a bed to keep you warm.
quests.explanation: A blanket keeps you warm while you sleep. 'Pull the blanket over' describes the natural action we do before falling asleep.
quests.textToSpeak: She pulled the warm blanket over herself and fell asleep.
quests.textWithBlanks: She pulled the warm ___ over herself and fell asleep.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: A chart showing the days, weeks, and months of the year.
quests.explanation: A calendar helps us remember important dates. 'Mark the date' is a common way to say you wrote something down so you wouldn't forget.
quests.textToSpeak: He marked the date of the meeting on his calendar.
quests.textWithBlanks: He marked the date of the meeting on his ___.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: A shop that makes and sells bread and cakes.
quests.explanation: A bakery is where bread, cakes, and pastries are made and sold. 'The smell of fresh bread' paints a clear picture of this cozy shop.
quests.textToSpeak: The smell of fresh bread came from the bakery next door.
quests.textWithBlanks: The smell of fresh bread came from the ___ next door.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: A stick of wax with a wick that you burn for light.
quests.explanation: A candle gives light and is often placed on birthday cakes. 'Light a candle' is the standard verb we use with this word.
quests.textToSpeak: She lit a candle on top of the birthday cake.
quests.textWithBlanks: She lit a ___ on top of the birthday cake.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: A paper cover used to send a letter by mail.
quests.explanation: An envelope is the paper cover we use to send letters by post. 'Seal it' means to close it firmly so the letter stays safe inside.
quests.textToSpeak: He put the letter inside an envelope and sealed it.
quests.textWithBlanks: He put the letter inside an ___ and sealed it.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: A small platform outside an upstairs window or room, with a rail.
quests.explanation: A balcony is an outdoor space attached to a building, often on a high floor. 'Watch the sunrise' describes a peaceful morning activity.
quests.textToSpeak: They drank coffee on the balcony and watched the sunrise.
quests.textWithBlanks: They drank coffee on the ___ and watched the sunrise.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: Two slices of bread with food like cheese or meat inside.
quests.explanation: A sandwich is a quick, popular lunch choice. 'Cheese sandwich' is just one example — you can also say chicken sandwich or egg sandwich.
quests.textToSpeak: She made a cheese sandwich for lunch.
quests.textWithBlanks: She made a cheese ___ for lunch.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: A case used to carry your clothes when you travel.
quests.explanation: A suitcase holds your belongings during a trip. 'Pack your suitcase' is essential vocabulary for anyone getting ready to travel.
quests.textToSpeak: He packed his suitcase the night before the flight.
quests.textWithBlanks: He packed his ___ the night before the flight.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: A soft cushion you rest your head on in bed.
quests.explanation: A pillow supports your head while you sleep. 'Soft pillow' is a natural pairing, since pillows are almost always described as soft or comfortable.
quests.textToSpeak: The baby fell asleep with her head on the soft pillow.
quests.textWithBlanks: The baby fell asleep with her head on the soft ___.
